stem: HCP Terraform practice check #4 (tf.004.8a): which statement is correct?

choices.text: Use a no-charge plan for hands-on; otherwise study docs/drills only
Always connect AWS access keys to HCP on a paid plan for this workbook
Agents should create HCP workspaces during implementation
Skip teardown for cloud resources managed outside Terraform

rationale: Workbook rule: HCP hands-on only on a no-charge path; never connect AWS credentials on a paid path; agents never operate HCP.
